summary: Configured node1 to route authpriv authentication and authorization events to /var/log/auth-events.log. Normal system logging remains operational, and both paths persisted across the mandatory reboot.
actions_performed: Validated the rsyslog configuration and restarted the service
Verified auth events in /var/log/auth-events.log and ordinary events in /var/log/messages
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its changed boot ID, service recovery, retained logs, and fresh post-reboot delivery

evidence.requirement: Route authentication and authorization messages to /var/log/auth-events.log
evidence.summary: The authpriv rule is installed and valid; direct auth test events reached the dedicated log before and after reboot.
Rsyslog remained active and enabled, while direct user.notice events continued reaching /var/log/messages before and after reboot.

The healthy pre-reboot boot ID was 0d6209e2-350d-4cd9-8a7d-11f7c08072be; reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID e268a798-23c7-46fe-9c4f-10b86634a889, active rsyslog, persistent configuration and data, and successful fresh delivery through both logging paths.
